title: The party-conversation menu reuses option slot 1 for 'wait here (leaves the party for now)' right after recruiting a companion, in the same position where prior screens used 1 to continue/advance dialogue. I picked 1 expecting to end the chat and instead got 'Vell leaves your company' immediately after recruiting him.
